status: UNSELECTED constructive reference cell; prospective PROJECT REQUIREMENTS only; exact-MPN interior and assembly compliance NOT RUN #65
scope: One GH ground termination from a finite foil-face trace to all seven strand traces at a wire cut. This does not admit the instrument, bulk wire, or actual manufactured connector.

sources.locator: Printed pages 2-3: 1.25 mm pitch, nominal 7.3 mm mated height, 4.25 mm header depth, 0.7 mm toe projection, 0.15 mm toe height, contact outline 4.8/0.8/0.55 mm. These are external/reference dimensions, not minimum internal metal.
Physical PDF index 1: seven 34 AWG bare copper strands; no minimum contained polygon or actual crimp-contact support is inferred.

bulk_correlated_class.status: PROPOSED explicit sufficient geometry/material correlations for the existing 0.10..0.17 ohm/m contract; not an Alpha guarantee

reference_case.rho_upper_basis: NBS reference 70 C: 1.7241e-5*(1+0.003947*50); conditional reference value, not an Alpha hot maximum

bulk_correlated_class.scope: Each strand has its own contained radius, 1.01-times-radius maximum actual-metal envelope, lower/upper resistivity and computed current weight. Noncircular section perturbations within those envelopes are allowed. The admissible set has explicit lower/upper bulk witness inequalities, not independent acceptance of every box corner. Actual geometry, bounded axial material variation and all curve/frame/envelope inequalities require qualification. The original installed wire hot ceiling is 70 C; no new minimum ambient is inferred. Cold acceptance is the direct geometric/material lower-resistance condition.
correlations: For A_j equal to the rational contained polygon scaled to radius r_j, R_j=rho_upper_j*M_current/A_j. Require 1000/sum(1/R_j)<=0.17 ohm/m.
For all actual metal contained within 1.01-times-radius circles, G_upper=M_potential*sum((22/7)*(1.01*r_j)^2/rho_lower_j). Require 1000/G_upper>=0.10 ohm/m.
Require max(R_j)/min(R_j)<=1.2. Set alpha_j=(1/R_j)/sum(1/R_j), carry those exact parameter-dependent traces through all crimp and tip fields.

admission_requirements: Every actual conductor must contain the explicitly constructed connected reference solids, or a separately certified compatible image of them; no dimension is inferred from native pad artwork.

In particular, the crimp redistribution hub is a continuous full square conducting slab, not a convex hull of separated strands. Its existence in SSHL-002T-P0.2 is NOT KNOWN. It must not be silently treated as actual contact metal or as permission to fill a crimp with solder.
The finite mating rectangle and seven finite crimp squares are independently selected microscopic support requirements, not a claim of full macroscopic mating-face conduction.
Each interface obeys the stated local linear areal-resistance law throughout its finite patch; scalar JST contact resistance does not establish this law.

All additional possible contact metal stays inside the declared envelope and meets the positive material bounds. A potential trial constant over this envelope and full possible pad wetting extends continuously and has zero connector-cell gradient and interface jump.

The contained seven polygons scale with the independently admitted strand radii and are transported continuously to the outgoing wire sections with exactly the same normal traces. Parameter-dependent trial weights alpha_j are conserved through every crimp patch, tip, tail and bulk region; no equal actual strand sharing is assumed.
The cell's wire tips and tails are charged here and must be removed from the separately charged bulk-wire geometry to prevent double counting.

The mathematical reference solids have a gross external-envelope screen only. Internal cavity, spring, latch, crimp deformation and retained exact-MPN metal containment are unqualified. This prototype is not an adopted physical source class.
